selector_rule: Inspect turvar/turth metadata and qualify only an explicit constant-price 2010 per-capita selector; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Do not substitute nominal per-capita or derive from var 672 in Stage 1A

selector_rule: Prefer direct source-native morbidity total selector if exactly identifiable; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Retain source definition and reference-period wording; no reinterpretation as diagnosed disease prevalence

selector_rule: Prefer direct kabupaten/kota total JKN coverage selector if exactly identifiable; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Do not treat administrative coverage as healthcare utilization or quality

selector_rule: Prefer source-native total category for persons age 5+ accessing internet in the last 3 months; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Universe and 3-month recall period must remain explicit

selector_rule: Use direct household adequate-sanitation access only if no hidden category aggregation is required; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Definition/methodology revisions must be retained by period

selector_rule: Use direct household adequate drinking-water source access only if no hidden category aggregation is required; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Do not conflate adequate drinking-water source with piped-water service

selector_rule: Use direct total dependency-ratio projection selector if exactly identifiable; otherwise hold
methodology_boundary: Projection-based evidence must remain projection/model estimate and never be relabeled observed

selector_rule: Inspect source categories only; no electricity-access indicator is authorized unless one source-native total-electricity selector exists
methodology_boundary: No PLN+non-PLN arithmetic or proxy relabeling in Stage 1A
